title: Sheriff / Law Enforcement
key_finding: The city's current law-enforcement page states that Deltona contracts with the Volusia Sheriff's Office to provide law-enforcement services to District 4 and the City of Deltona.

title: FY2024-25 Annual Budget - Law Enforcement Services
key_finding: The FY2024-25 budget says Deltona has contracted VSO law enforcement since incorporation in 1995, organizes law enforcement as contracted services, names a district commander rather than a police chief, budgets 89 contract personnel, and publishes Deltona-labeled crime/service performance measures.

title: FY2024 Annual Comprehensive Financial Report
key_finding: The FY2024 CAFR says the City contracts with the Volusia County Sheriff's Department via an interlocal agreement for law-enforcement services in the City.

title: VSO General Orders Manual - Jurisdictional Responsibilities
key_finding: VSO's jurisdiction manual says the sheriff has primary jurisdiction of all law enforcement in Deltona, DeBary, Pierson, and Oak Hill.

title: Law Enforcement Websites
key_finding: The sheriff's official county police-links page lists Volusia's municipal police/public-safety departments and Deltona is not listed among them.

title: Addresses and Phone Numbers
